bullets.title: AAPL: Q4 beat but Q1 margin/Services guide misses; stock -4% premarket
bullets.body: AAPL Q4 revenue $114.48B beat by ~1% (iPhone +17.5%, Mac +23.7% y/y) with EPS $2.10 including $0.05 tariff refund. Q1 gross margin guided 45-46% vs 46.5% consensus, Services guided +8-9% vs +10% expected, and gross margin faces ~300bps y/y decline through FY27 as memory costs and tariff benefits fade. Sell-side 57% Buy / 30% Hold / 13% Sell at avg PT $335.76; NTM P/E 35x vs. 5-yr avg 28x prompts debate on whether dip gets defended.

bullets.title: PLTR: 96% revenue growth, 165% NRR — but flat backlog and logo deceleration raise peak-growth debate
bullets.body: Palantir Q3 revenue grew 96% y/y with US Commercial +148% and US Government +96%; adj. operating margin guided to 61.5% and FCF margins to 57%. Sequential backlog was flat for the first time in 3.5 years and new logo adds fell to 33/quarter from 40-45, which UBS flags as a potential peak-growth signal. Company is intentionally allowing shorter-duration contracts to reduce friction for sovereign AI deployments; NRR of 165% supports the bull case despite deceleration concerns.

bullets.title: MRVL/LITE: $80B all-stock deal — Oppenheimer bullish, investors skeptical, stock -13%
bullets.body: Marvell is acquiring Lumentum in an all-stock deal valuing LITE at ~$80B ($684/share at 4.5x MRVL shares); expected to close 1H28. Oppenheimer reiterates Outperform on MRVL ($425 PT), seeing a vertically integrated AI connectivity platform with combined 2030 TAM of $550B (+$60B) and >$1B cost synergy target. However, Wolfe Research notes no investors encountered favor the deal, citing cyclical optical risk, fab fixed-cost addition, and concern that LITE CEO's financial incentive raises questions about optical market timing; MRVL trades at 12x CY28E EPS vs AI peers at 18x.

bullets.title: SHOP: Q3 operationally strong but -16% on GMV miss vs low-30s guidance
bullets.body: Shopify Q3 revenue $3.74B (inline), operating income +66% y/y to $568M, FCF $816M — all solid. But GMV of $119B missed $120B consensus and Q4 revenue guided 'low-30s%' y/y, which fell short of elevated positioning; stock -16% on expectations reset. Q4 margin headwinds flagged from deliberate infrastructure and shifted marketing spend; cumulative GMV expected to surpass $2T by end of 2026.

bullets.title: ON Semiconductor: DC strength (+160% AI revenue y/y) offsets auto miss; CY27 guide conservative
bullets.body: ON Q3 EPS $0.90 beat ($0.88e), AI Data Center revenue $180M (+160% y/y) with full-year AI DC now expected ~$620M (+140%); Industrial revenue $467M beat while Auto $777M missed on supply reallocation to DC. Q4 AI DC revenue implied +215% y/y and management comfortable with +2% q/q Q1 revenue vs. consensus -1.7%. Wolfe estimates CY27 revenue guidance of 14-15% y/y appears conservative on a segment-by-segment build; Wells Fargo cut PT to $90 from $100, Needham holds $116.

bullets.title: ANET: F3Q26 preview — Street at $3.335B revenue, AI guidance and supply constraints in focus
bullets.body: Arista F3Q26 consensus expects revenue $3.335B (vs $3.30B guidance floor), gross margin 62.8%, EPS $1.08 at guidance high-end. F4Q26 consensus steps to $3.601B. Company previously guided FY26 AI revenue to 'at least $3.5B'; investors focused on billings growth trajectory and supply chain constraints amid robust hyperscaler spending. Report imminent.

bullets.title: AMD: F3Q26 preview — Data Center/GPU ramp and Helios reception are key
bullets.body: Street expects AMD F3Q26 revenue $13.1B vs $13.0B guidance midpoint with Data Center at $8.2B; F4Q26 consensus jumps to $16.3B with DC at $11.6B. Key focus: Helios GPU ramp cadence, customer reception, and whether DC revenue growth accelerates sequentially as guided. PC demand remains a headwind per recent INTC/MSFT results. Wolfe Research hosting post-earnings webcast Nov 4 at 10:30am.

bullets.title: Internet valuations reset: GOOGL/META/AMZN at 14-21x 2026E EPS after sharp declines
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley notes North America Internet fell ~8% recently, led by GOOGL -13%, SNAP -16%, RBLX -19%, RDDT -36%; AMZN/GOOGL/META now trade at 18x/14x/21x 2026E EPS, down 3%-42% vs TTM averages. MS maintains Attractive industry view, seeing the pullback as an entry point rather than a thesis break.

bullets.title: NVDA: +2.3% premarket; FT reports instruction to redirect data center clients away from Chinese customers
bullets.body: NVDA traded +2.3% in premarket. FT reports Nvidia is instructing data center clients to make the majority of clients non-Chinese, an incremental export control development to watch. No earnings revisions in the window; the stock remains a focal point in the broader AI infrastructure debate.

bullets.title: MU: AAPL memory demand driving 4-5x earnings multiple; DRAM undersupply persists into 2027
bullets.body: Citi projects 2027E DRAM supply/demand ratio at -3.8% (improved from -8.7%) and NAND at -3.3%, with server DRAM demand +53% y/y and eSSD +52% y/y. AAPL pre-paid $33B to mitigate memory risk, benefiting MU at a 4-5x earnings valuation per channel commentary. Memory suppliers pursuing LTAs rather than spot price hikes to lock in demand.

bullets.title: FISV: Project Elevate savings doubled to $1B; Clover 4Q inflection is the credibility test
bullets.body: Fiserv Q3: banking attrition improved >25% YTD with peak attrition behind; Merchant organic revenue -2% vs flat expected but 4Q inflection guided; Clover GPV growing at low end of 10-15% ex-gateway conversion. Company doubled Project Elevate savings target to $1B from $500M (back-end weighted post-2027) and resumes $500M buybacks in Q4. JPM flags investor credibility depends on steep Q4 Clover ramp.

bullets.title: CRWV: On Hedgeye short list; JPM NDR with management on Nov 11
bullets.body: CoreWeave remains a Hedgeye short on 11/3 amid broader AI neocloud de-risking (neoclouds -35% in October per JPM recap). JPMorgan is hosting a virtual NDR with CoreWeave co-founder/CDO, CFO, and VP Corp Dev on November 11 following 3Q earnings.

bullets.title: RBLX: Downgraded to Underperform, PT cut to $35 on weak Q4 bookings and margin pressure
bullets.body: Zach AM Attack reiterates Underperform on Roblox, cutting PT to $35 citing weak Q4 bookings and accelerating investment pressure; FY27 EBITDA margins modeled to contract to 15.8%. Morgan Stanley also flagged RBLX -19% in the broader Internet selloff.

bullets.title: ROKU/FOXA: Morgan Stanley bullish on merger; record $350M political ad revenue, Fox One scaling
bullets.body: MS flags FOXA/ROKU merger as accretive in FY29 at ~3x net leverage with PF EBITDA of $3.8B (FY27) and $4.8B (FY28). FOXA posted F1Q revenue +22% to $4.6B with EBITDA +54%; political advertising hit a mid-term record of $350M. Roku reported +24% revenue growth to $1.5B with TTM FCF approaching $800M; 9th consecutive quarter of double-digit ad growth.

bullets.title: ORCL: 86.2M share secondary priced at $116; stock down ~9% in prior session
bullets.body: Oracle priced an 86.2 million share secondary offering at $116.00. The stock was flagged down approximately 9% in the Hedgeye macro show context on the same day, likely linked to broader tech/AI sentiment rather than the secondary alone.

bullets.title: APP (AppLovin): Jefferies hosting e-commerce customer expert calls post-Black Friday Dec 4
bullets.body: Jefferies is hosting two expert calls on December 4 with AppLovin e-commerce customers (Burton Snowboards, Naked & Thriving Cosmetics) to assess D2C ad performance over the holiday season and early 2027 marketing budget visibility across the platform.

bullets.title: CDNS/SNPS: Trade lower on Anthropic IPO roadshow touting Claude chip design capabilities
bullets.body: Cadence and Synopsys both traded lower after The Information reported Anthropic is emphasizing Claude's chip design capabilities to prospective IPO investors, raising competitive concerns for EDA incumbents.

bullets.title: VST: Texas midterm utility commission outcome key for 474 GW data center interconnection queue
bullets.body: Texas holds ~474 GW of interconnection queue with ~90% attributed to data center demand; a Dec 10 ERCOT audit is cited as a near-term catalyst for Vistra. Regulatory commission outcomes in TX, GA, and OH may matter more than gubernatorial results for long-term data center policy and power demand exposure.

bullets.title: UBER: Pershing Square flags as high-upside holding; AV seen as complement not replacement
bullets.body: Pershing Square's Q3 earnings call highlighted Uber as a major upside bet with strong earnings growth at an unusually low valuation. Management expressed view that autonomous vehicles are more likely to complement than replace Uber's network, reducing a key bear case overhang.

bullets.title: Hedgeye macro: Nasdaq >20% drawdown by Q2 2027; short NBIS, CRWV, IREN; only TSLA bullish in Mag 7
bullets.body: Keith McCullough targets >20% Nasdaq decline by Q2 2027 in 'Quad 4' downturn; maintains shorts on NBIS, CoreWeave, IREN, and DRAM. Within Mag 7, Tesla is the only name he remains bullish on — Microsoft 'broke trade,' Apple 'at risk.' Long equal-weight RSP as hedge vs. concentrated tech. Reducing software exposure and raising cash.
